text_block_list.name: Former Classmate
text_block_list.text:
...Hmm, you really went
to Tracen Academy. I thought you were joking.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...This has nothing to do with you.

text_block_list.name: Former Classmate
text_block_list.text: ...It doesn't suit you, you know? That uniform.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For a while, Narita Taishin seemed
deeply downcast...
